def transform(grid):
 rsep=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==0 for x in row)]
 csep=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j]==0 for i in range(len(grid)))]
 def spans(n,seps):
  out=[]; start=0
  for x in seps+[n]:
   if start<x: out.append((start,x))
   start=x+1
  return out
 rs=spans(len(grid),rsep); cs=spans(len(grid[0]),csep)
 return [[int(sum(grid[i][j]==8 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d))>1) for c,d in cs] for a,b in rs]
out=transform(g); print(out)
